## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage4 grinder identified a parameter combination that improves edge capture on J's winner days while limiting losses on loser days, driven by tighter premium-based stops and volatility-adjusted entry filters. The edge likely stems from avoiding low-quality breakouts and capturing sustained ribbon rides.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Requires premium-based TP trigger (`tp_premium_pct=0.75`), volatility filter (`vol_ratio_threshold=1.2`), and Chandelier arm (`chandelier_arm_pct=0.6`) to confirm momentum. Strike selection uses `strike_offset=2` (OTM-2 puts).  
**Exit:** Premium stop at `stop_premium_pct=-0.35` (−35% of entry premium) and time stop at `time_stop_min=12` minutes. The Chandelier trail locks gains as the move extends.
